messages:
kevin: Noticed the weekly base image rebuild failed in staging: cosign sign step returning PermissionDenied from KMS. Pausing the rebuild pipeline until we confirm RBAC and logs.

infra-rob: Error text?

kevin: Pod log: 'rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller does not have permission to use key version'. cosign command: `cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/builder-key`

tanya: Last IAM change on that key was 2026-04-10 by me to remove broad editors. I intended to replace with workload identity binding. Maybe the k8s SA mapping wasn't applied.

sec-bot: AUTO: KMS IAM delta detected. Removed binding: serviceAccount:legacy-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-04-10T14:02Z. New binding added: workloadIdentity:builder-wi@redwood-prod at 2026-04-10T14:02Z.

auditor-lee: Also seeing that KMS Admin logs for 14:00-14:10 are missing in our audit sink. Sink `audit-to-logs` reported a config error yesterday. Need to backfill before changing IAM.

infra-rob: Agreed — we'll export existing logs to gs://redwood-audit/SEC-5200/ then add the legacy SA back temporarily to unblock staging.

ci-bot: Note: adding legacy SA back will allow signing but will bypass WI protections. Recommend short TTL and tickettracking.

kevin: Proposed steps:
1) Export logs (infra-rob)
2) Rebind legacy-builder to roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter temporarily (infra-rob)
3) Re-run staging rebuild and capture evidence (kevin)
4) Fix WI mapping in k8s and CI (tanya)
5) Remove temp binding (infra-rob)

infra-rob: Export started -> gs://redwood-audit/SEC-5200/manifest.json. Rebinding now with note SEC-5200-temp-rebind.

sec-bot: Audit: backfill complete (partial). Some entries unrecoverable due to sink downtime.

auditor-lee: Capture what we have and tag evidence. We'll document the retention gap.

infra-rob: Temp binding added at 2026-04-10T14:18Z. ttl planned: 1h.

kevin: Re-run staging rebuild... cosign sign succeeded at 2026-04-10T14:22Z. Image pushed to staging.

tanya: I'll push WI mapping patch to infra repo and a small README for onboarding (CI change also). Will create PR and link here.

ci-bot: CI will add a check that `cosign sign` in pipeline returns non-PermissionDenied for expected principal.

auditor-lee: Evidence packet created: gs://redwood-audit/SEC-5200/evidence.zip. Ticket created SEC-5200 (medium).

infra-rob: Leaving temp binding until WI mapping merged and verified. manual cleanup ETA 2h.

kevin: Thanks. Follow-ups: WI docs, CI preflight, alert on missing KMS logs. Filing small action items under SEC-5200-1/2/3.

tanya: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/812. Please review.

sec-bot: Suggestion: add terraform-managed IAM for keys and a terraform plan drift alert to catch future accidental removals.

kevin: Closing hold on staging once PR merged and temp binding removed. Will not rollout to prod until auditor sign-off.
